title: Quick Fried Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A crowd-pleasing Mediterranean dish featuring tender lamb, flavored with apple juice and a blend of spices, perfect for a quick and delicious meal. This low-carb friendly dish is sure to satisfy any appetite.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together apple juice, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat about 2-3 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and carefully add to the hot oil.
Fry the lamb for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Remove the lamb from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or oregano if desired.
